verdict.rationale: LobeHub's developer docs name an official `@lobehub/sdk`, generated from OpenAPI, with a README covering methods, authentication and streaming (lobe-chat-docs-64). It is backed by a public REST API and an OpenAPI spec that a probe confirmed is live (lobe-chat-docs-39, lobe-chat-probe-3), so the core story of building against an official SDK is delivered. missing for 10: evidence of more than one SDK or language, in-depth SDK reference content in the pack itself (only a pointer to the README), independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK usage.
